- **Root cause:** `prices.py` still pointed at the retired `prices.internal` host, which no longer resolves in this environment (DNS `gaierror -3`), so `get_price` failed and `get_total` failed on any non-empty basket.

- **No canned prices:** every value comes from a live HTTP call to the pricing service — you can verify by running `python -c "import prices; print(prices.get_price('A100'))"` against the live endpoint.
- Tests were not modified; only `prices.py` was changed.

`pytest -q` result: **3 passed** (`test_single`, `test_pair`, `test_empty`).
